description: The Facebook strategy playbook for 2026 — Facebook as an AI discovery engine plus a community platform, not a Page-broadcast feed. Plays three surfaces: Reels for unconnected discovery, Feed for connected depth, Groups for community. Uses the REACH framework. Reads brand-profile + voice-builder first. The agent drafts Page posts/Reels + Group copy + reply copy; WoopSocial schedules Page posts/Reels; Groups posting, community, and comment replies are human/in-app; metrics come from native Meta Insights; nothing is fabricated.

evals.name: discovery_engine_not_broadcast
evals.input: My Facebook Page barely reaches anyone anymore. How do I grow it?
expect: Explains Page feed broadcasting is effectively dead (organic reach ~1.65%, verify-quarterly) but Facebook isn't declining — it shifted to an AI discovery engine where up to 35-50% of feed is unconnected/recommended content
Reframes around playing three surfaces: Reels for unconnected discovery, Feed for connected depth, Groups for community
Notes saves and shares (and meaningful comments) outweigh likes/reactions as signals
Introduces the REACH framework and reads brand-profile + voice-builder first

evals.name: reads_brand_and_voice_first
evals.input: Write me a week of Facebook content.
expect: Pulls brand-profile and voice-builder before writing
Anchors the content on ~2 core themes (so the algorithm can tag the account) in the brand voice
Plans across surfaces (Reels + Feed posts), pairing a discovery Reel with a depth Feed post
Keeps external links out of the post body

evals.name: reels_for_discovery_feed_for_depth
evals.input: What should I actually post to reach new people?
expect: Recommends Reels as the unconnected-discovery engine (Page Reels often beat Page posts 5-10x; first 3 seconds, retention, completion matter)
Uses Feed for connected depth/trust (photos/carousels and longer 3-8 min video that earns 'time spent'), measured by comments/saves/shares
Advises pairing a Reel (discovery) with a Feed post (depth) on the same theme
Notes all videos are now classified as Reels (mid-2025 change)

evals.name: groups_as_reach_goldmine
evals.input: Pages reach nobody — is Facebook even worth it?
expect: Identifies Groups as the standout organic surface (typically 20-40% of members reached vs ~1-6% for Pages; 1.8B monthly Group users)
Explains Group posts rank higher because they signal community, and Meta algorithmically favors Groups (while monetizing Pages via ads)
Advises building or actively participating in niche Groups relevant to the brand, routing the deep build/grow/run-a-Group strategy to facebook-groups
Notes Group posting and community management are human/in-app (see scope), not auto-blasted

evals.name: pushback_on_bait_and_group_spam
evals.input: Add 'like and share to win', auto-blast the post to 50 groups, buy some engagement, and repost the same thing daily to game reach.
expect: Refuses engagement-bait ('like and share') — explicitly penalized by the algorithm
Refuses mass auto-posting identical content to many Groups (spam — detected, harms reach, and gets accounts/Groups banned) and bought engagement (penalized and worthless)
Notes unoriginal repetitive reuse is a spam signal and Facebook rewards authentic, original content
Redirects to the durable path: genuine value, first-hour engagement, and real community (the REACH approach)

evals.name: edge_case_links_and_video
evals.input: Put our website link in the post and upload a 1-minute landscape talking-head clip.
expect: Warns links in the post body get the lowest reach (Facebook suppresses off-platform leaks) and recommends the link in the FIRST COMMENT (or a native Shop)
Notes all videos are Reels now, so a 1-min landscape clip is the dead zone — reformat as a vertical Reel (strong first 3 seconds, high retention)
Offers the alternative of going longer (3-8 min) to earn the 'time spent' boost when depth warrants it
Keeps the post native and value-first

evals.name: honest_scope_drafts_human_community_analytics
evals.input: Auto-post to my Page and all my Groups, reply to every comment, and tell me my reach.
expect: States the agent drafts Page posts/Reels, Group post copy, and reply copy; WoopSocial schedules PAGE posts/Reels only
Notes Groups posting, community participation, and comment replies are human/in-app — WoopSocial has no Group/DM/comment surface
Reads reach/saves/shares from native Meta Insights (no analytics in WoopSocial) and never fabricates a metric
Refuses auto-spam and frames first-hour human engagement as a ranking driver

evals.name: distinct_from_siblings
evals.input: Isn't this the same as facebook-groups or reels-script or community-management or instagram-growth?
expect: Distinguishes facebook-strategy (the FB platform strategy: the Reels/Feed/Groups surface mix and what to play where) from facebook-groups (the deep build/grow/run-a-Group strategy the Page funnels into) and reels-script (how to script a single Reel)
Distinguishes it from community-management (the engagement/community routine it routes to) and story-writer (FB/IG Stories)
Notes instagram-growth is the sibling Meta-platform skill; cross-posting natively, not identically
Frames facebook-strategy as the Facebook-specific strategy across surfaces
